description: Where Bitcoin sits in its cycle by on-chain measures — realized-profit, holder-behaviour and valuation indicators rather than price alone.
name: get_bitcoin_cycle_position

available.description: False when this call has no data — a snapshot that is not warm yet, a domain switched off, or an argument that was rejected. NOT an error, and NOT a statement about the market.

dormantSupplyPct.description: Share of supply dormant. Null when not in this pass.

exchangeFlow.description: Exchange inflow/outflow and the net signal.

fetchedAt.description: When the underlying snapshot was refreshed (epoch ms or ISO-8601). Age matters: these are cached reads, not live queries.

mvrv.description: MVRV ratio with its cycle signal and 7d trend.

signal.description: What that level has historically meant.

nvt.description: NVT ratio. Null when the metric is not in this pass.

realizedCap.description: Realized cap. Null when not in this pass.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

stale.description: True when the snapshot is past its refresh interval.

timeSeries.description: History behind the metrics, one point per day.

txVolume.description: On-chain transaction volume. Null when not in this pass.

title: Bitcoin On-Chain Cycle
